testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and expand a template group ✔ Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the metric part template group is expanded ✔ And a sheet-metal part template is selected ✔ When the user collapses the part template group ✔ Then its template tiles are hidden ✔ And the assembly and drawing groups remain visible ✔ And the selected template's details remain displayed ✔ When the user expands the part template group ✔ Then its template tiles are visible again ✔ And the sheet-metal template remains selected
